5b03461b90922765af5e9c69649642df6ecc9af4.sourceText:
| 转换方式 | 主要用途 | 安全程度 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `static_cast<T>(expr)` | 常规类型转换，如数值、枚举、父子类上行转换 | 常用，编译期检查 |
| `dynamic_cast<T>(expr)` | 多态类型的安全向下转换 | 运行期检查，失败返回 `nullptr` 或抛异常 |
| `const_cast<T>(expr)` | 添加或移除 `const` / `volatile` 限定 | 要非常克制 |
| `reinterpret_cast<T>(expr)` | 底层二进制重解释，如指针和整数互转 | 最危险，少用 |
5b03461b90922765af5e9c69649642df6ecc9af4.translatedText:
| Conversion method | Primary use | Safety level |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `static_cast<T>(expr)` | Conventional type conversion, such as numeric, enum, and parent\-child class upcasting | Commonly used, compile\-time checking |
| `dynamic_cast<T>(expr)` | Safe downcasting of polymorphic types | Runtime checking, returns `nullptr` on failure or throws an exception |
| `const_cast<T>(expr)` | Add or remove `const` / `volatile` qualifiers | Use very sparingly |
| `reinterpret_cast<T>(expr)` | Low\-level binary reinterpretation, such as converting between pointers and integers | Most dangerous, use sparingly |
